description: Seeks feedback on daily accessibility barriers.
Draft accessibility plan report due August.
Committee focuses on five accessibility work plan areas.

chips.text: Committee members discussed scooter parking and snow clearing concerns.
Survey targets people with disabilities, older adults, care providers.
Scooter parking and snow clearing methods impact people with disabilities.
City staff will use survey data to guide departments on barrier removal.

segments.title: Update on accessibility funding and survey
segments.takeaway: Mr. Calvaz provided an update on the city's accessibility funding and announced an upcoming online survey to gather feedback on accessibility barriers.

segments.title: Questions and discussion on accessibility survey
segments.takeaway: Committee members discussed the accessibility of the upcoming survey and focus groups, including accommodations for deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals.

segments.title: Motion to receive accessibility update
segments.takeaway: A motion was made and passed to formally receive the verbal update on accessibility funding and the upcoming survey.

segments.title: Subcommittee updates
segments.takeaway: The committee received verbal updates that the Education and Awareness of Community and Deafblind subcommittees are working to schedule future meetings.

segments.title: Motion to receive subcommittee updates
segments.takeaway: A motion was made and passed to receive the information regarding the subcommittees' efforts to finalize meeting dates.

segments.title: Work plan considerations for 2025
segments.takeaway: The committee began discussing its work plan for 2025, focusing on approved categories and identifying potential projects for the year.

segments.title: Discussion on transportation and scooter accessibility
segments.takeaway: Committee members discussed focusing on bus rapid transit accessibility and the ongoing issue of improperly parked scooters, which create barriers for residents.

segments.title: Discussion on deafblind services and document accessibility
segments.takeaway: The committee discussed the need for more emphasis on deafblind services and accessible city documents, awaiting a report back in Quarter 1.

segments.title: Discussion on snow clearing methods and accessibility
segments.takeaway: A committee member raised concerns about snow clearing methods impacting accessibility, particularly for wheelchair users and access to trails and parking.

description: Committee's 2025 work plan focuses on accessibility.
Includes Deafblind Services, Access Transit, Bus Rapid Transit.
Also covers Civic Accessibility, Safety, and Downtown.

chips.text: Committee requested a report on snow removal policy changes and budget impacts.
Snow removal changes impact Access Transit users' mobility.
